items.snippet_en: The claim that Prime Minister Modi is providing 3 months of free mobile recharge to all Indians is false. The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check Unit has debunked such claims, stating no such scheme has been announced. The government advises citizens to visit myscheme.gov.in for legitimate scheme information.
